definitions.explanation: The higher portion of a layered structure, whether physical (atmosphere, soil, water) or social (class, organization).

examples.japanese: ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上層|じょうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: The upper layers of the atmosphere have low temperatures.

examples.japanese: {上層|じょうそう}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理職|かんりしょく}→管理職：21834_kanrishoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。

{上層|じょうそう}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なっていた→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The lifestyle of the upper class was vastly different from that of ordinary citizens.

notes:
Used both for physical layers (atmosphere, soil, ocean) and metaphorical ones (social class, organizational hierarchy). The physical sense is common in science and weather reports; the social sense appears in discussions of class, management, and power structures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上層|じょうそう}⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧: upper atmosphere
- {上層|じょうそう}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: upper echelon/division
- {上層|じょうそう}⟦{階級|かいきゅう}→階級：05515_kaikyuu⟧: upper class
- {上層|じょうそう}⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧: upper floor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下層|かそう}→下層：11372_kasou⟧: lower layer/stratum — the opposite
- {中層|ちゅうそう}: middle layer
- ⟦{表層|ひょうそう}→表層：21091_hyousou⟧: surface layer — the outermost part, not necessarily the highest
